answerExplanation: The maths is right, but tiny counts make "tripled" sound far more alarming than it is.

contentBody: **A redesign launched the same week signups rose. What's the careful description?**
option.1: "Signups rose the same week; other causes not ruled out."
answerExplanation: Happening together is correlation, not proof the redesign caused it.

option.3: "A/B test a new onboarding email for 2 weeks; measure activation rate."
answerExplanation: It names a specific, testable action and exactly how success is measured.
